blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY— Police arrested all five regional-level most wanted persons in the Cordillera Administrative Region during manhunt operations conducted across the region in October, the Police Regional Office-Cordillera (PRO-CAR) said. In a report on Monday, Oct. 26, PRO-CAR said the five suspects, listed as the region’s top most wanted persons for the fourth quarter of 2026, were facing charges involving rape and sexual assault. The No. 1 most wanted person, a 20-year-old man wanted for 10 counts of statutory rape, was arrested by joint operatives of the Abra Police Provincial Office’s Provincial Intelligence Unit in Barangay Dalayap, Langiden, Abra.
